(06) FAQ

Straight
answers

What is the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) helps your website rank in Google's regular results. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) structures your content as clear answers so it can appear in featured answers and voice search. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) helps AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI Overviews understand, trust and cite your brand. I work on all three together, because they rely on the same foundation: a fast, well-structured site with clear, factual content.

Do you work with clients outside Pakistan?

Yes. Most of my projects are for businesses in Canada, and I have also worked on websites for clients in the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates and Saudi Arabia. I work remotely and adjust to your time zone for calls.

Which platforms do you build websites on?

Mostly WordPress with Elementor, including WooCommerce stores. I have also worked on Shopify, Next.js and custom-coded websites.

Can you optimize my Google Business Profile?

Yes. I have optimized more than 25 Google Business Profiles, covering categories, services, descriptions, photos, location pages on the website and local citations.

How do you report SEO progress?

With data from Google Search Console and Google Analytics 4: impressions, clicks, rankings for target keywords, indexed pages and the leads your website brings in.

Do you also edit videos for social media?

Yes. I edit reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok and YouTube videos, promo ads and motion graphics using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects and CapCut, and design graphics in Photoshop and Canva.
